stories.headline: Google ships Gemini 4 Argon on Cloud
stories.summary: Google made Gemini 4 Argon generally available on Google Cloud, Gemini for business, AI Studio, and Antigravity.
stories.why_it_matters: A major new model release with immediate enterprise access and pricing.

stories.headline: UB backs public-good AI statement

stories.why_it_matters: It adds higher-ed pressure for policy, governance, and public AI infrastructure.
